metadata.title: Tensor Factorization of Extension Ideals under Gluing: a Torsion-Length Law and Huneke–Wiegand Counterexamples with Many Generators
metadata.description:
Let Γ = a1·Γ1 + a2·Γ2 be a gluing of numerical semigroups, k a field, and A = a1·A1 + a2·A2 the extension of relative ideals A_i of Γ_i. With y acting as t^a2 on k[Γ1] and as t^a1 on k[Γ2], we prove I_A ⊗ I_{A*} ≅ T1 ⊗_{k[y]} T2, where T_i = I_{A_i} ⊗ I_{A_i*}. The torsion lengths satisfy ℓ(τ(T)) = a1·ℓ(τ(T1)) + a2·ℓ(τ(T2)) + Σ_{j≥1} b1(j)·b2(j), with b_i(j) the number of Jordan blocks of size at least j of y on τ(T_i); the numbers of minimal generators multiply, and A has the Huneke-Wiegand property exactly when a factor is a non-principal ideal with it.

This re-proves two propositions of García-Sánchez and Leamer and settles the case they leave open. Because the conjecture is false in dimension one, it yields counterexample ideals with 2^r minimal generators over symmetric numerical semigroup rings, among them four-generated examples with Frobenius numbers 23645 and 53599. Exact computation, by the definition of the tensor product and by Leamer's partition criterion, confirms the law on 200 seeded gluings and on 48 gluings with large factors, 36 of them with a counterexample factor and 18 with an extension that is itself a counterexample; an independent implementation agrees on every audited case. The two four-generated examples rest on the proof and the partition criterion, since their direct torsion is not computed. The results concern monomial ideals.

Source code, compact artifacts and proofs: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH .

metadata.version_notes: Validation extended to gluings with a counterexample factor (48 gluings, 36 with a counterexample factor, two independent routes; 18 extensions are themselves counterexamples); algorithms with pseudocode, the degree-bound lemma with proof, and the cost model; results tables and figures generated from the experiment artifacts; bibliography completed with journal data and DOIs; citation pointers re-checked against arXiv:1211.2896v1 and arXiv:1211.4554v1; related work extended; Frobenius number and symmetry of a gluing derived; embedding dimension of the two-parameter family proved; completion argued; evidence marks on every result and a claim audit; corrected the DOI of the Huneke-Wiegand 1994 reference. The theorem and its proofs are unchanged.
